_note: Design tokens for Devin launch videos. Color, type, radius and shadow values are pulled from the Devin marketing design file in Figma (evS5ExlrnLrUCMPm395OHw: devin.ai homepage, Devin Cloud, Devin Desktop pages). Spacing scale and motion are house rules for the videos. Treat as the source of truth across all templates.

_figma.fonts: NB International Pro (display + body), Geist Mono (labels/code)
_figma.fontFallback: NB International Pro is a licensed font and is not bundled. Templates use Inter (same grotesk proportions, tight tracking) via @remotion/google-fonts unless the font files are available locally; Geist Mono is on Google Fonts.

type.display: 'NB International Pro', Inter, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
type.body: 'NB International Pro', Inter, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
type.mono: 'Geist Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
type.weightNote: The Devin site uses only Regular and Medium. Headlines are Medium, not bold. Mono labels are uppercase 11px with +0.04em tracking on the site (scale to ~18px at 1080p).

radiusNote: Site buttons are nearly square (2px); screenshot figures are 10px; feature cards are 16px.

rules: ease-out for entrances, ease-in-out for moves, ease-in for exits
no more than two motion types per scene
one idea on screen at a time
generous negative space; nothing on screen that isn't doing work
